subject: boxplot where x is an factor

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: boxplot where x is an factor
parts:
Hi,

If x of qplot is not a factor, qplot plots a single boxplot instead of
many boxplot (each for each coordinates). I'm wondering how to do so.
(Note that I can not simply convert x into a factor, because the
values in x reflects the actual position of the boxplot.)

library(ggplot2)
dframe=data.frame(
x=do.call(
c
, lapply(
1:10
, function(i) {rep(i,10)}
)
)
, y=do.call(
c
, lapply(
1:10
, function(i) {rnorm(10,i)}
)
)
)
qplot(x,y,data=dframe,geom='boxplot')


--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: 907a8a1e9542efdf
messages.subject: Re: boxplot where x is an factor
parts:
Hello,

Try this:

ggplot(dframe, aes(x=x, y=y, group=x)) + geom_boxplot()

(note the group=x setting)

or this:

ggplot(dframe, aes(x=x, y=y)) + geom_point() + stat_summary(fun.data =
"mean_cl_boot", colour = "red", geom="crossbar")

(stat_summary plots something similar to a boxplot on top of your points)

Hope this helps,
Jonas
